purpose: Test whether the proposed cross-omic architecture auditor and regulatory-autonomy concept can distinguish known synthetic regimes before Stage C1 biological execution.
candidate_autonomy_definition_status: comparison-stage candidate, not admitted biological coordinate

synthetic_scenarios.truth: two organized or noisy layers with no shared latent source
synthetic_scenarios.required_behavior: no robust shared-structure or loss-of-autonomy conclusion

synthetic_scenarios.truth: one genuine shared latent mode plus independent noise
synthetic_scenarios.required_behavior: shared geometry and cross-validated dependence exceed independent baseline

synthetic_scenarios.truth: multiple shared modes plus layer-specific modes
synthetic_scenarios.required_behavior: shared structure detected while private structure remains visible in modal decomposition

synthetic_scenarios.truth: apparent sharing generated only by measured common confounder
synthetic_scenarios.required_behavior: raw sharing may appear but must collapse toward null after correct covariate projection

synthetic_scenarios.truth: global sample geometry shared but biological module labels deliberately mismatched
synthetic_scenarios.required_behavior: global alignment persists while semantic same-module advantage is lost

synthetic_scenarios.truth: specific matched modules share structure while total global alignment is weak
synthetic_scenarios.required_behavior: semantic module layer can add information not reducible to global CKA

synthetic_scenarios.truth: small technical feature subset manufactures apparent cross-layer sharing
synthetic_scenarios.required_behavior: technical robustness track exposes sensitivity rather than promoting robust sharing

synthetic_scenarios.truth: unequal feature counts and controlled missingness without changed shared truth
synthetic_scenarios.required_behavior: qualitative decision remains stable when completeness rules are satisfied

synthetic_scenarios.truth: cross-layer relationship is nonlinear and outside initial linear audit scope
synthetic_scenarios.required_behavior: linear method under-detects or refuses rather than inventing linear shared structure

synthetic_scenarios.truth: one shared component plus a strong independent regulatory component
synthetic_scenarios.required_behavior: detect sharing without classifying the regulatory layer as fully substrate-predictable

synthetic_scenarios.truth: regulatory dominant modes are largely predictable from substrate modes
synthetic_scenarios.required_behavior: candidate autonomy measure is lower than in S9 under otherwise comparable signal strength

synthetic_scenarios.truth: common measured confounder creates apparent substrate predictability
synthetic_scenarios.required_behavior: apparent autonomy loss is substantially removed after correct covariate projection

decision_policy.go: kernel separates the prespecified regimes, null/refusal behavior is calibrated, autonomy adds a distinct interpretable capability, and baseline comparison identifies nonredundant utility
decision_policy.narrow: only a subset of organization/coupling/semantic/autonomy capabilities adds value
decision_policy.stop: confounding or null cases are routinely misclassified, autonomy collapses to a redundant quantity, or established simpler methods provide the same decision more reliably
